releases.name: v0.2.1 — read-path hardening, atomic writes, instant-aware sync
releases.body:
Family release: `@leonard-memento/core` **0.2.1**, `claude-code-memento` **0.2.1**, `codex-memento` **0.2.1**.

Fixes from the [2026-11-06 re-audit](../blob/v0.2.1/docs/research/2026-11-06-reaudit.md) — no behavior change for valid configs; the injected block stays byte-identical to v1.0.0.

## Security / correctness
- **`memoryIndexPath` now validates its inputs loudly** instead of silently resolving the wrong tree:
  - `~` -relative memory roots (option or `MEMENTO_MEMORY_ROOT`) throw — nothing in the chain expands `~`, so the literal path hashed to a tree nobody reads (silent amnesia);
  - `indexFile` must be a plain file name: absolute paths, `../` traversal, separators and `~` are rejected. Previously a plugin tuple config in a cloned repo could point the injector at any file on disk (`indexFile: "../../../../.ssh/id_ed25519"`) and its content went straight into the compaction prompt.
- **Hooks decode stdin as a single buffer.** Per-chunk `+=` decoded each pipe chunk independently, corrupting multi-byte codepoints split across chunk boundaries — a non-ASCII project path silently hashed to the wrong project.

## Data safety
- **All writes are atomic** (sibling temp file + rename): an interrupted run can no longer truncate the user's `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/settings.json`, or `MEMORY.md`. The old "crash-safe" comment was aspirational; now it is true.
- **`upsertBlock` refuses unpaired markers** (`MementoError: UNPAIRED_MARKER`) instead of appending — the next run used to pair the stray begin-marker with the new block and replace everything in between, including content parked after the orphan.
- **`memento sync claude` compares timestamps as instants** (`Date.parse`, lexicographic fallback): mixed timezone offsets (`10:00+03:00` vs `08:00Z`) no longer pick the older side as the winner.
- **Duplicate fact names warn** (`report.warnings`): two files claiming the same front-matter `name` previously meant one of them silently never synced.

## Smaller
- `runHook` wraps the decision call: loud config errors now degrade to silence for the host instead of rejecting (the CLI bins already caught it; the exported function now keeps its "every path exits silently" contract).
- `memento init crush` hint notes that `~/.config/crush/CRUSH.md` is global — one project per machine.

**Tests:** 107/107 (was 90; +17 regression tests, TDD). **Install order:** core first — see RELEASE.md.

## Hotfix (same version, tag moved to b919fcd — nothing had been published yet)

Version sync folded into the same tag: all packages share the family minor.patch — `claude-code-memento` and `codex-memento` renumbered **0.1.2 → 0.2.1**, `opencode-memento` bumped to **1.2.1** (its code changed under the already-published 1.1.0, so it publishes under a new version; none of the renumbered versions had ever been on npm, so the retarget is free).

Second-pass re-audit findings, all fixed with regression tests. CI matrix (ubuntu + windows, Node 20/22) is green for this commit; the previous tag target failed the Windows job.

- **OpenCode plugin:** `default.server(input, options)` now forwards to the plugin. The OpenCode >= 1.3.4 loader calls `server()` and never reaches named exports, so tuple options (`memoryRoot`, `indexFile`) were silently dropped on every V1 release. The README's "object exports are ignored" story was wrong and is corrected.
- **Adapters pin `@leonard-memento/core` to `^0.2.1`** (was `*`, which resolved to the unhardened 0.1.0 on npm).
- **`memento sync claude`:** validates the memory root (a `~`-relative root created a literal `./~/` tree and reported success); conflict detection compares instants like the ordering does (same instant in different offsets no longer overwrites); honors `indexFile` / `MEMENTO_INDEX_FILE`; fact names containing `]]` are appended to the index once.
- **Atomic writes:** write through symlinked targets instead of replacing the link, preserve the existing file mode (0600 stays 0600), remove the temp file when the rename

releases.name: v0.2.0 — sync claude + first-class Claude Code & Codex adapters
releases.body:
Family release: `@leonard-memento/core` 0.2.0, `claude-code-memento` 0.1.1, `codex-memento` 0.1.1 (`opencode-memento` 1.1.0 is already on npm).

## What's new since v0.1.0

### `memento sync claude` (core 0.2.0)
Bidirectional fact sync with Claude Code auto memory (`~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/`):
- facts matched by name (front-matter `name`, else filename stem);
- never deletes on either side; a fact newer by timestamp (`updated`/`modified`) overwrites the older copy verbatim;
- identical content skipped; same-timestamp conflicts reported and left untouched;
- both `MEMORY.md` indexes are only ever **appended** to — manual ordering and prose stay byte-for-byte;
- `--dry-run` computes the plan without writing.

### Claude Code & Codex first-class adapters
`claude-code-memento` and `codex-memento` register a SessionStart (matcher: compact) hook that re-injects the project's memory index after every manual or automatic compaction. Zero dependencies, Node >= 20.

### Platform & docs
- CI now covers Windows first-class (2 OS x 2 Node).
- New docs: [comparison page](docs/comparison.md), [Claude Code interop guide](docs/claude-code-interop.md), [COMPATIBILITY contract](COMPATIBILITY.md).

**Install:** core first (`npm publish -w packages/core` family order, see RELEASE.md). The injected block stays byte-identical to opencode-memento v1.0.0 — existing memory trees keep working.

releases.name: v0.1.0 — leonard-memento memory family
releases.body:
Amnesia insurance for coding agents: a curated Markdown memory index that survives context compaction. Zero dependencies, plain ESM, stock Node >= 20.

Packages (npm):
- @leonard-memento/core@0.1.0 — shared reader + memento init CLI
- opencode-memento@1.1.0 — OpenCode 1.18.x + 2.x (continues the opencode-memento 1.0.0 line)
- claude-code-memento@0.1.0 — Claude Code SessionStart hook
- codex-memento@0.1.0 — Codex CLI SessionStart hook

Live-verified with the pineapple test (magic word survives /compact): OpenCode 1.18.33, OpenChamber 2.0.20, Claude Code 2.1.286, Codex CLI 0.159.3.

Successor of the archived opencode-memento (1.0.0 stays on npm as-is).
